span.p:
Twilio + SNS
SMS 30 sec atki
-> 2-3 sec me jawab nahi to chhodo (timeout), har company alag
5 fail -> circuit OPEN, SNS pe, 30 sec baad ek test call (circuit breaker)
push / email -> har company ka apna circuit breaker
SNS bhi band -> line me ruke, OTP ka alert
